compute_split_info_from_directory: compute split info for dataset splits in a given data directory with optional filename template
compute_split_info: compute split statistics including num shards and num examples from a filename template
split_infos_from_path: restore split info metadata from previously computed JSON files in a directory
process_split: process a single dataset split using Apache Beam to compute shard-level statistics
process_shard: process a single shard to count examples and compute total bytes size
